title: 3.2 Law of Cosines

icans: I can use the Law of Cosines to solve oblique triangles (SSS or SAS).
I can decide whether to use the Law of Sines or the Law of Cosines.
I can use Heron’s Area Formula and solve real-life problems.

vocab: a² = b² + c² − 2bc cos A  (and the same __________ for b² and c²)

blocks.sec: Part 1 · What if it isn’t a right angle?
